_comment: Owner-maintained delegation ceiling (AGENT-OPT-04). Model lists are ordered weakest first. Subagents use the same or a weaker model than the session and an effort no higher than the session's (a strictly weaker model may go weaker_model_extra_effort_levels higher, never above max_subagent_effort; with 2 and high, weaker models may always use up to high). Update model names when the owner adopts newer versions. Keep byte-identical in both furnace repositories.
